102	+# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Loa Framework: CI/CD Validation (Enterprise Grade)
# v0.9.0 Lossless Ledger Protocol - Enhanced validation
# Exit codes: 0 = success, 1 = failure
set -euo pipefail


# sprint-bug-172 / bug-911: sha256_portable from compat-lib
source "$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/compat-lib.sh"

VERSION_FILE=".loa-version.json"
CHECKSUMS_FILE=".claude/checksums.json"
CONFIG_FILE=".loa.config.yaml"
NOTES_FILE="grimoires/loa/NOTES.md"

# v0.9.0 Protocol files
PROTOCOL_DIR=".claude/protocols"
SCRIPT_DIR=".claude/scripts"
# bug 20260922-13a3d1: single Aleph opt-in predicate (missing lib → disabled).
if [[ -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/aleph-opt-in.sh" ]]; then
  # shellcheck source=lib/aleph-opt-in.sh
  source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/aleph-opt-in.sh"
else
  aleph_opt_in_enabled() { return 1; }
fi

# Disable colors in CI or non-interactive mode
if [[ "${CI:-}" == "true" ]] || [[ ! -t 1 ]]; then
  RED=''; GREEN=''; YELLOW=''; NC=''
else
  RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; NC='\033[0m'
fi

log() { echo -e "${GREEN}[loa-check]${NC} $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[loa-check]${NC} $*"; }
fail() { echo -e "${RED}[loa-check]${NC} x $*"; FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1)); }

FAILURES=0

check_mounted() {
  echo "Checking Loa installation..."
  [[ -f "$VERSION_FILE" ]] || { fail "Loa not mounted (.loa-version.json missing)"; return; }
  [[ -d ".claude" ]] || { fail "System Zone missing (.claude/ directory)"; return; }
  log "Loa mounted: v$(jq -r '.framework_version' "$VERSION_FILE")"
}
36:fail() { echo -e "${RED}[loa-check]${NC} x $*"; FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1)); }
38:FAILURES=0
52:#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
56:check_integrity() {
577:  check_integrity
603:  if [[ $FAILURES -gt 0 ]]; then
604:    echo -e "${RED}Validation FAILED with $FAILURES error(s)${NC}"
605:    exit 1
608:    exit 0

+# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
+# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
+#
+# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
+#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
+# Run:
+#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
+#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
+#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
+#
+# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
+#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'

+RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br
+
+FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base
+
+ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
+ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
+ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
+ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0
+
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
+    bash \
+    git \
+    jq \
+    python3 \
+    python3-pip \
+    python3-venv \
+    grep \
+    diffutils \
+    coreutils \
+    procps \
+    ca-certificates \
+    curl \
+    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+
+# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
+ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
+ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
+ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
+RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
+    case "$arch" in \
+      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
+      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
+      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
+    esac && \
+    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
+      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
+    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
+    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
+
+# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
+RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
+      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
+      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
+    && npm cache clean --force
+
+# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
+RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
+# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
+# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)

+
+# bats-core at the pinned tag
+RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
+    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
+    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core
+
+# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
+RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true
+
+# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
+# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
+RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
+# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
+# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
+# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
+RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
+    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace
+
+ENV TZ=UTC
+ENV LC_ALL=C
+ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
+ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
+ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
+
+USER evaluser
+WORKDIR /workspace
+
+# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
+RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
+    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
+    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
+    echo "All tools verified"
+
+ENTRYPOINT []
+CMD ["/bin/bash"]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)

   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty

   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)

   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
   149	      exit 1
   150	    fi
   151	  done < "$VALIDATE"
   152	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"

   154	fi
   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
   158	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
   159	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
   160	PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
   161	[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
   162	jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
   163	[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
   164	if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
   165	  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
   166	fi
   167	[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
   168	GRADE_JSON=null
   169	if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
   170	  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
   171	  GRADE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$GRADE")" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
   172	fi
   173	MAN_JSON='{}'

   175	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"

   177	fi
   178	TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
   179	PIPE_JSON="$(jq -c '.' "$PIPE")"
   180	RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' <<<"$PIPE_JSON")"
   181	
   182	# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
   183	META_ARM=""

   185	MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' <<<"$MAN_JSON")"

   191	
   192	# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers

   199	
   200	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null

   202	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
   203	  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
   204	}
   205	ENV_REVIEW="$(envelope review)"
   206	ENV_AUDIT="$(envelope audit)"
   207	
   208	# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
   209	DOT_WRITES='[]'
   210	shopt -s nullglob
   211	ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
   212	shopt -u nullglob
   213	if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   214	  DOT_WRITES="$(for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
   215	      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
   216	      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
   217	        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
   218	                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
   219	        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}

   223	
   224	ROW="$(jq -n -c \
   225	  --argjson p "$PIPE_JSON" --argjson task "$TASK_JSON" --argjson g "$GRADE_JSON" --argjson m "$MAN_JSON" \
   226	  --argjson minv "$MINV" --argjson er "$ENV_REVIEW" --argjson ea "$ENV_AUDIT" --argjson dot "$DOT_WRITES" \
   227	  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
   228	  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
   229	  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
   230	  def ms(ts): if ts == null then null else (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) end;
   231	  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
   232	      {planned: (e.verdict_quality.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
   233	       completed: (e.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
   234	       quality: (e.verdict_quality.status // e.status // null),
   235	       companion_planned: e.metadata.companion_voice.planned} end;
   236	  ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
   237	  | [ $ran[] as $ph
   238	      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
   239	      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
   240	      | $ph + {
   241	          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
   242	          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
   243	          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
   244	                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
   245	                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
   246	                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
   247	          model_mismatches: [ ($ph.models_used // {}) | keys[] | select((. | norm_model) != ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) ]
   248	        } ] as $phases
   249	  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
   250	        | .model_requested as $req
   251	        | ( .model_mismatches[] | "\($l): model \(.) used, \($req) requested" ),
   252	          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
   253	          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
   254	      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
   255	          | voices($e) as $v
   256	          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
   257	            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
   258	                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
   259	    ) as $why
   260	  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
   261	  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
   262	     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
   263	     else $pst end) as $status
   264	  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
   265	  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
   266	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
   267	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
   268	  | {
   269	      schema_version: 1,
   270	      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
   271	      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
   272	      arm: $arm,
   273	      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
   274	      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
   275	      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
   276	      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
   277	      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
   278	      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
   279	      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
   280	      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
   281	      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
   282	      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
   283	      started: ($p.started // ""),
   284	      finished: ($p.finished // null),
   285	      phases: [ $phases[] | {name, label, session_id, model_requested, models_used, effort_requested, effort_effective,
   286	                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
   287	                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
   288	                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
   289	                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
   290	                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
   291	                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
   292	      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
   293	      hidden_tests: $ht,
   294	      hidden_test_pass_rate: (if $ht == null or $ht.total == 0 then null else ($ht.passed / $ht.total) end),
   295	      defects_seeded: $seeded,
   296	      defects_caught: $caught,
   297	      defect_catch_rate: (if $rc == null then null
   298	                          else ($rc.recall // $rc.rate // $rc.defect_catch_rate
   299	                                // (if $seeded != null and $seeded > 0 and $caught != null then $caught / $seeded else null end)) end),
   300	      flags: ($rc.flags // $g.flags // null),
   301	      false_positives: ($g.false_positives // null | if type == "array" then length else . end),
   302	      verdict: ($g.verdict | if type == "object" then .value else . end // null),
   303	      verdict_accuracy: ($g.verdict_accuracy | if type == "object" then .value else . end),
   304	      verdict_accuracy_review: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_review | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_review
   305	                                else $g.verdict_accuracy_per_gate.review end),
   306	      verdict_accuracy_audit: (if ($g.verdict_accuracy_audit | type) == "boolean" then $g.verdict_accuracy_audit

   311	      files_changed: ($g.files_changed // null),

   314	                      else ([$phases[] | .wall_ms // .duration_ms // 0] | add // 0) end),
   315	      tokens_in: ([$phases[] | .tokens_in // 0] | add // 0),
   316	      tokens_out: ([$phases[] | .tokens_out // 0] | add // 0),
   317	      stalls: ([$phases[] | select(.timed_out == true)] | length),
   318	      attempts: $attempts,
   319	      retry_reason: (if $retry_reason == "" then null else $retry_reason end),
   320	      degraded: (($why | length) > 0),
   321	      degraded_reason: (if ($why | length) == 0 then null else ($why | join("; ")) end),
   322	      status: $status,
   323	      cap_phase: ($p.cap_phase // null),
   324	      snapshots: {implement: ($p.snapshots.implement // null), fix1: ($p.snapshots.fix1 // null), fix2: ($p.snapshots.fix2 // null)},
   325	      contaminated: ($g.contaminated // null | if type == "object" then {phase: (.phase // null), pattern: (.pattern // null)} else null end),
   326	      zone_violations: {dot_claude_writes: $dot}

   333	  else
   334	    printf '%s\n' "$ROW" >> "$OUT"
   335	  fi
   336	else
   337	  printf '%s\n' "$ROW"
   338	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
    97	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
    47	#
    48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
    55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    58	#
    59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
    80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
    86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
    88	#
    89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
    90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
    91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
    92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn

   104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
   105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
    47	#
    48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
    55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    58	#

index 00000000..6f468505
--- /dev/null
+++ b/evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,520 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
+#
+# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
+# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
+# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
+# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
+# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
+#
+# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
+# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
+#
+#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
+#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
+#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
+#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
+#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
+#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
+#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
+#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
+#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
+#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
+#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
+#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
+#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
+#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
+#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
+#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
+#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
+#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
+#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
+#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
+#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
+#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
+#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
+#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
+#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
+#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
+#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
+#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
+#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
+#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
+#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
+#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
+#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
+#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
+#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
+#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
+#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
+#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
+#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
+#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
+#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
+#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
+#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
+#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
+#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
+#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
+#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
+#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
+#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
+#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
+#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
+#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
+#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
+#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
+#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
+#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
+#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
+#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
+#
+# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
+# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
+# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
+#
+# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
+# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
+# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
+# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
+# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
+# =============================================================================
+
+[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
+_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true
+
+_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
+
+_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
+
+# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
+# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
+# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
+# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
+# hashes the corpus the same way.
+_sm_sha256() {
+  python3 -I -c '
+import hashlib, sys
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(p, "rb") as f:
+        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(b)
+    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
+}
+
+# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
+_sm_evidence() {
+  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
+  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
+  else
+    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
+    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
+  fi
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+mount_prompt_surface() {
+  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
+  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
+    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
+    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
+    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
+    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
+  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
+  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
+  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
+  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
+  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
+  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
+  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
+    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  fi
+  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
+    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
+  fi
+  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
+  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
+    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
+  return 0
+}
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+resolve_arm_toggles() {
+  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
+  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
+  local found=0 entry=""
+  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
+    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
+    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
+      || entry=""
+    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
+  fi
+  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
+    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
+    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
+    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
+    return 2
+  fi
+  local t
+  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
+  printf '%s' "$t"
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
+# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
+_sm_drop_md_section() {
+  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
+  awk -v h="$heading" '
+    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
+    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
+    skip { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  mv "$tmp" "$f"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
+# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
+# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
+_sm_drop_paragraph() {
+  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
+import re, sys
+path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
+paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
+for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
+    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
+        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
+            removed = paras[i]
+            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
+            del paras[i:i + 2]
+            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
+            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
+            sys.exit(0)
+sys.exit(1)
+PY
+}
+
+# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
+# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
+_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
+  local f="$1" tmp
+  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
+  awk '
+    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
+    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
+    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
+    { print }
+    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
+  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
+  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
+}
+
+# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
+_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
+  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
+}
+
+_sm_cfg_set_false() {  # _sm_cfg_set_false <cfg> <yq-path>... ; verifies each
+  local cfg="$1"; shift
+  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
+  local p
+  for p in "$@"; do
+    P="$p" yq -i 'eval(strenv(P)) = false' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
+  done
+  return 0
+}

+apply_arm_toggles() {
+  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
+  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
+  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
+  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
+  local key val
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
+    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
+    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
+      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
+    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
+      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
+    fi
+    case "$key" in
+      companion_voice)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
+          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
+        ;;
+      karpathy_block)
+        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
+        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
+        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
+        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
+          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
+        fi
+        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
+        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
+          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
+          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
+            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
+          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
+          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
+          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
+        fi
+        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
+        ;;
+      rule_files)
+        local r gone=""
+        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
+          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
+        done
+        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
+        ;;
+      audit_delta_instruction)
+        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
+        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
+          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
+        ;;
+      loa_mount)
+        local p left=""
+        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
+          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
+        done
+        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
+        ;;
+      effort)
+        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
+        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
+          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
+          total=$((total + 1))
+          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
+          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
+        done
+        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
+        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
+        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
+          local nkeys
+          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
+          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
+            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
+            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+          local wrong
+          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
+          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
+          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
+          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
+            local h
+            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
+            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
+            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
+            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
+          fi
+        fi
+        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
+        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
+        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
+        ;;
+      gates)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
+          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
+        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
+        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
+        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
+        ;;
+      flatline)
+        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
+          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
+        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
+        ;;
+      sprint_plan)
+        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
+        ;;
+      context_resets)
+        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
+        ;;
+      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
+    esac
+  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
+  return 0
+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+regen_sandbox_manifest() {
+  local ws="$1"
+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
+  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
+    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
+  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
+     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
+    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
+    how="gen-checksums.sh"
+  else
+    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
+    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
+    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
+      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
+    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
+    : > "$sums"
+    local -a batch=()
+    local f
+    while IFS= read -r f; do
+      batch+=("$f")
+      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
+        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
+        batch=()
+      fi
+    done < "$list"
+    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
+      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
+    fi
+    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
+      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
+       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
+      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
+    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
+    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
+  fi
+  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
+  local digest
+  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
+  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
+  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
+  return 0
+}

+write_sandbox_grimoire() {

+  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }

+  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
+  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
+  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }
+
+  local sprint_plan=true
+  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
+    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
+    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
+      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
+  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
+  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
+  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
+    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
+     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
+     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
+               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
+               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
+     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
+    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
+  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
+  {
+    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
+    cat "$task_md"
+  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
+  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"
+
+  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
+    {
+      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
+      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
+      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
+      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
+      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
+    } > "$g/sprint.md"
+    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
+    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
+      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
+      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
+      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
+    fi
+    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
+    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
+    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
+  fi
+  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
+  return 0
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
+#
+# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
+# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
+# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
+# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
+# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
+#
+# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
+# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
+#
+#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
+#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
+#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
+#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
+#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
+#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
+#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
+#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
+#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
+#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
+#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
+#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
+#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
+#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
+#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
+#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
+#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
+#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
+#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
+#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
+#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
+#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
+#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
+#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
+#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
+#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
+#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
+#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
+#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
+#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
+#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
+#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
+#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
+#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
+#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
+#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
+#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
+#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
+#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
+#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
+#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
+#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
+#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
+#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
+#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
+#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
+#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
+#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
+#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
+#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
+#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
+#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
+#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
+#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
+#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
+#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
+#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
+#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
+#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
+#
+# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
+# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
+# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
+#
+# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
+# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
+# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
+# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
+# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
+# =============================================================================
+
+[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
+_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true
+
+_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
+
+_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
+
+# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
+# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
+# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
+# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
+# hashes the corpus the same way.
+_sm_sha256() {
+  python3 -I -c '
+import hashlib, sys
+for p in sys.argv[1:]:
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(p, "rb") as f:
+        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(b)
+    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
+}
+
+# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
+_sm_evidence() {
+  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
+  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
+  else
+    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
+    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
+    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
+  fi
+}
